nodes.title: FLUX NOTE
widgets_values:
FLUX DEV/SCHNELL


  * FLUX ON/OFF: ON = FLUX IS ACTIVE
  * LORA ON/OFF: ON ACIVATES THE LORA NODE FOR FLUX
  * FLUX DEV HYPER 8 STEP LORA - SET TO 0.125
  * ENABLE/DISABLE FLUX LORA AS NEEDED AND LOAD CORRECT CLIP/VAE
  * SET GUIDANCE IN THE PROMPT NODE BETWEEN 3-5

nodes.title: SD 3.5 NOTE
widgets_values:
STABLE DIFFUSION 3.5 TURBO

  
  * FLUX ON/OFF: OFF = SD 3.5 TURBO IS ACTIVE
  * SET GUIDANCE IN THE PROMPT NODE TO 1 AND CHANGE VAE IF NEEDED
  * MODEL SAMPLING = SHIFT 3
  * STEPS = 4-5
  * SD 3.5 LARGE NORMAL AND SD 3.5 MEDIUM WILL NOT WORK IN THIS WORKFLOW

This is a high-quality digital artwork featuring a mysterious, dark-haired figure draped in a long, flowing black cloak, sitting by a foggy river. The figure's face is obscured, adding an air of enigma. The background is an ancient, dilapidated stone bridge, partially covered in moss and surrounded by rocks and tangled vines, creating a sense of decay and abandonment. The color palette is muted with dominant blues, grays, and earthy tones. The image employs a shallow depth of field, with the background slightly blurred, drawing focus to the figure. The composition uses leading lines from the bridge and river, guiding the viewer's eye towards the central figure. The lighting is soft and diffused, enhancing the ethereal, melancholic atmosphere. The camera angle is at eye level, providing an immersive perspective. The overall aesthetic is hauntingly beautiful, with a very high subjective quality.
